AUTHOR:
François Marie Arouet de Voltaire
 (1694–1778)
 
QUOTATION:
In the best of possible worlds the château of monseigneur the baron was the most beautiful of châteaux, and madame the best of possible baronesses.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Candide. Chap. i.
